name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe
storyline:
Plankton’s robotic minions have gone amok all throughout Bikini Bottom, not wanting to obey their master’s commands and throwing him out of his own restaurant.

As the situation gets out of control, Spongebob, Patrick and eventually Sandy form together to stop the threat of the robots. Finding out for themselves on who had orchestrated this smeckldorf of a robotic takeover!
summary: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe is a full game mod of Battle for Bikini Bottom created by Gravity. It is an expansion of the original Battle for Bikini Bottom featuring 200 Golden Spatulas, over 30 new areas, new collectables, Game Options, and so much more.
